archetypes.name: dyn-step5-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 cached-stall recovery and live rejoin paths are stateful and retry-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 5 review wrapper changes for retry idempotency and state safety. Focus on whether cached complete results are still reused, cached stall results are cleared before fresh starts, and live registry rows cannot spawn duplicate review bgjobs. Check the harness expectations and contract docs for drift from the shell behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
